_doc: Which shared gates have PROVEN they can fail, and how.
READ BY checks/check_probes_pass.py, through checks/_calibration.py. Every entry is verified
against the estate before this file is believed: the key must name a gate that exists, a cited
prover must resolve and be COMMITTED, and a prover inside this repo must have had its claimed
self-proof run green by the same sweep. An entry naming no gate, no file, no commit or no
running proof is a FINDING (SUPERSOTA R7: a registry nothing reads is a rumour).
These gates run in four repos, so their proof belongs HERE rather than inside any one
consumer -- two of them were canaried from inside ZeroThunder, which meant the other three
inherited the gate without the evidence.
proven_by: the canary runs each check against a git repo containing a real violation and
asserts it goes RED, then against a clean tree and asserts GREEN. Red-on-violation is the
load-bearing half: a gate that scans nothing exits 0 and is indistinguishable from a gate
that scanned everything, and two fixtures in this very table were silently out of scope
Keys name the gate WITHOUT its check_ prefix, and a prose claim that names no prover file
(an in-selftest: entry) is left to the sweep rather than resolved here. Regenerate the canary
citations with the canary, never by hand -- a registry a human types is a registry that

proven_by.audit_ignores: tests/test_rust_audit.py (run by this repo's push gate; skipped where cargo-audit is not installed): an ignored advisory that no longer fires against the lockfile is red, an ignored one with no `# reason` on its line is red, a reasoned one that still fires is green, and a tree with no Cargo.lock is refused rather than passed. Calibrated 2026-10-14 (BACKLOG 6.21): with both refusals disabled, the stale and the unreasoned cases went red
proven_by.baseline_ratchet: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- a ratchet may not grow: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.busy_loop: tests/test_check_busy_loop.py (the native `goh busy-loop`, run by this repo's push gate): a tracked shell file that runs a backgrounded busy loop is red and names the file and the line, and the house way is named; a file that only QUOTES the loop (a string, a heredoc body, a comment) is green, because text is not code; a file that is not shell is green; a foreground busy-wait (`until <cond>; do :; done`, or `while :; do :; done`) is red while a loop that sleeps or `read`-drains is green (G17); `# load-ok: <reason>` on the line or on the comment lines directly above it is green, while a marker with no reason and a marker nothing needs are red; the INDEX is judged at --staged; and the scope is printed on every run. Calibrated 2026-10-21
proven_by.ci_local_parity: checks/check_ci_local_parity.py --probe: red on a script only CI runs, an exemption CI no longer runs, an exemption the local gate now runs and a scan under its floor, green on a clean one and on a covered CI-only script, and a repo with no workflows is refused rather than passed; tests/test_check_ci_local_parity.py breaks the comparison, the stale ratchet and the floor one at a time. Calibrated 2026-10-18
proven_by.claim_derivation: tests/test_check_claim_derivation.py (the native `goh claim-derivation`, run by this repo's push gate): every claim type red-before and green-after -- lines, tests, declared-by-name, files-by-extension, and the backtick spelling -- plus the negative controls that must stay quiet (a bare number beside a path, a version, a heading anchor, prose ABOUT a claim, a fenced example, an indented example). The estate's own defect is a case: a label carrying a second space is COUNTED, where the re.findall that read 64 against 70 matches 1 of 4 against the same roster. Every printed re-derivation command is EXECUTED against its fixture and compared with the number the gate returned. Ten unresolvable shapes are findings naming why, not skips; the allowlist ratchet is proven in both directions
proven_by.dep_currency: tests/test_check_dep_currency.py (the native `goh deps`, run by this repo's push gate): a pin below the graph is red and a pin at or above it is green; an inherited workspace requirement is resolved against the root and a dict-valued one does not crash; an empty tree declares itself not applicable
proven_by.display_seam: checks/check_display_seam.py --probe: 71 shapes and 4 config errors behave as declared, each a hand draw, a screen capture or a frame count left unchecked going red and its seam-routed twin green. Calibrated 2026-10-14 (BACKLOG 6.21): with the Swift presentation rule disabled, 24 cases went red
proven_by.empty_scope: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- every gate refuses to pass over an empty tree: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.estate_corpus: checks/check_estate_corpus.py --probe: a checker that cannot fail is caught against real estate files, a corpus below its floor is refused, and a real entry verifies end to end. Calibrated 2026-10-14 (BACKLOG 6.21): with the not-caught branch disabled, the probe went red
proven_by.exclusion_has_ceiling: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- line exclusions retain a ceiling: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.file_length: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- file length cap: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.generated_fresh: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- generated artifacts are fresh: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.git_env: checks/check_git_env.py --probe: a raw git spawn, a stale exemption, a shell site that runs no git and a census that read no Python each refuse, and a call through the seam is left alone. Calibrated 2026-10-14 (BACKLOG 6.21): with the raw-spawn finding dropped, the probe went red
proven_by.js_syntax: tests/test_check_js_syntax.py (the native `goh js-syntax`, run by this repo's push gate): a tracked source with a stray backtick is red and names the file and the line, under node AND under the JavaScriptCore fallback that reads it with no node installed; the goal is the BROWSWER'S, so a top-level `return` and a top-level `await` are red under BOTH engines (node --check read the CommonJS goal and accepted both), a `.js` file carrying module syntax is red, a `.mjs` file is green and is named in the report as a module, and a `.cjs` file with a top-level `return` is green; a template whose substituted form does not parse is red; a template that is NOT JavaScript on its own is green, because its placeholder is filled in before it is parsed; a source the engine cannot read is refused rather than passed; and a floor above the real count is red. Calibrated 2026-10-21; recalibrated 2026-10-22 (the goal, the engine order and the browser's classic script)
proven_by.lints_optin: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- workspace members inherit lints: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.lock_version: tests/test_check_lock_version.py (the native `goh lock-version`, run by this repo's push gate): app_updates' real 2026-10-01 shape -- manifest 1.36.0, Cargo.lock 1.35.0, both members INHERITING -- is red; regenerating the lockfile is green; a release number bumped in one place only is red; per-crate versions are a layout and produce no finding; a member list spread over lines is read whole and an exclude below it is not mistaken for a member
proven_by.mcp_wire: tests/test_check_mcp_wire.py (run by this repo's push gate): a planted stdio server breaks each rule once and goes red for its NAMED reason -- an older negotiated protocol (legacy and discovery), no annotations, an unstated hint, a destructive tool listed by default, no outputSchema, a non-object outputSchema, a stale or unreasoned GOH_MCP_UNSTRUCTURED entry, a silent server at its timeout, a server that exits -- and a compliant server goes green; the hung server's child and a green server's detached child are both gone afterwards. Calibrated 2026-10-26 by breaking the destructive rule and the descendant reap once each (both went red), and against antiknob's real rmcp server: green as started, red with --allow-destructive
proven_by.md_links: tests/test_check_md_links.py (the native `goh md-links`, run by this repo's push gate): the audit's hand-mis-derived anchor (#48-what-90-can-actually-do-measured) is red and the right one is green; a missing file is red; a link in an inline code span, a fenced block or an indented block is an example and produces nothing
proven_by.no_allow: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- no Rust #[allow]: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.no_conflict_markers: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- no conflict markers: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.no_credential_urls: tests/test_credential_urls_native_parity.py (the native `goh credential-urls`, run by this repo's push gate): the MEASURED table is 26 shapes -- 22 remote-URL forms read back through git's own config reader and CPython urlsplit, plus 4 about the KEY rather than the URL -- each row's verdict equal to the frozen reference's. Green on `ssh://git@github.com/...`, on `git@github.com:o/r.git`, on `file://`, a local path, `git://`, an IPv6 literal and `https://someuser@github.com/...`; RED on `https://user:gho_<36>@...`, on the bare `https://gho_<36>@...` shape, and on an `ssh://` remote carrying a token. The report carries a sha256 fingerprint and never the value, pinned by a planted credential (tests/test_check_no_credential_urls.py)
proven_by.no_emoji: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- no disallowed emoji: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.no_empty_assert: tests/test_check_no_empty_assert.py (the native `goh empty-assert`, run by this repo's push gate; the measured clippy 1.99.0 table of 2026-10-02 is a Rust test beside the port): the six shapes clippy reports AND the two it is silent on, `assert!(x.is_empty(), "msg")` and `assert!(!x.is_empty(), "msg")`, which is why the gate exists at all; the forms clippy tells you to write (`assert_eq!(x.len(), 0)`, `assert_ne!`) stay green; a multi-line chain is reported at its `assert!` line; a `)` inside a message does not end the scan
proven_by.no_home_paths: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- no hard-coded home paths: red on `cd /Users/someone/Projects/thing`, green on `${THING_DIR:-$(dirname "$0")}` (2026-09-19, the day the gate landed)
proven_by.no_kill_by_name: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- no process kill by name: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.no_screen_linkage: tests/test_screen_linkage.py (run by this repo's push gate; skipped where no cc): object files compiled on this machine, one importing a forbidden symbol (red) and one clean (green), read through real nm output. Calibrated 2026-10-14 (BACKLOG 6.21): with the finding's exit disabled, two cases went red
proven_by.no_screen_presentation: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- tests never take the screen: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.no_secrets: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- no committed secrets: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.no_unreaped_spawn: tests/test_unreaped_spawn_native_parity.py (the native `goh unreaped-spawn`, run by this repo's push gate): the MEASURED table, 55 shapes in tests/unreaped_spawn_table*.py, each disposition measured against rustc 1.99.0 by a pid-liveness probe on 2026-10-03 (spawn+drop = LIVE orphan; kill without wait = ZOMBIE; a guard reaps through a panic; output()/status() BLOCK instead of leaking), every row's whole verdict list equal to the frozen reference's. The incident itself is a case, QUOTED from media_server at 052772a: red on the real pre-fix file naming the first panicking line and the reap below it, GREEN on the same file after its fix
proven_by.probes_pass: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- gate self-proofs still pass: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.python_formatted: tests/test_check_python_formatted.py (the native ruff-format step, run by this repo's push gate): a mis-formatted file is red and a formatted one green, at both scopes; a missing ruff is a failure, not a skip; the gate never reformats
proven_by.shell_lint: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- shell lint: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.skills_corpus: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- skill corpus has valid frontmatter: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.subprocess_stdin: tests/test_subprocess_stdin_seed.py (the native `goh subprocess-stdin`, run by this repo's push gate): an undeclared stdin is red and a seeded one passes as counted debt; a call added after the seed is red; with tests/test_subprocess_stdin_scope.py, an exclusion that hides every Python file and a scan below its declared call floor are red
proven_by.swift_warnings: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- a warning in our sources fails, a dependency's does not: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.tag_version: tests/test_check_tag_version.py (the native `goh tag-version`, run by this repo's push gate): a pushed v<semver> tag whose commit declares another version is red; red on media_server's real 2026-10-01 shape (tag v1.79.3, commit declaring 1.79.1), green on a matching pair, and a tag with no version source is a finding
proven_by.tests_registered: game_asset_factory/tools/check_gate_canary.py -- every test is registered: red on a violation, green on a clean tree
proven_by.version_provenance: tests/test_check_version_provenance.py (the native `goh version-provenance`, run by this repo's push gate): red on a version with no commit and no date; a version declared in src/lib.rs is REACHED rather than read as not-applicable; an opaque clause field whose build script never asks about the working tree is red; a baseline entry naming a file the checker never reads is a FINDING; green on a truthful version
proven_by.tracked_build_output: tests/test_check_tracked_build_output.py (run by this repo's push gate): a tracked build output is red and names the file and the shape, a clean tree is green, a repository that tracks nothing is REFUSED rather than passed, and a build output that is only on disk is left to .gitignore. Calibrated 2026-10-20

unproven_why.check_swift_coverage: needs a built Swift package with real coverage data; a fixture would be a Swift toolchain invocation, not a file
